## Summary

The IEEE registry lists 12 MA-L blocks to "SHENZHEN RF-LINK TECHNOLOGY CO.,LTD." at Building 56A, Baotian Road 3, Bao'an District, Shenzhen [1]. The one product the session could document is the Shenzhen RF-Link WL-UM01C-7601, a 1x1 802.11b/g/n USB 2.0 Wi-Fi adapter on a MediaTek MT7601U, made in China under FCC ID 2AGQ3UM01C [2]. No source consulted states the grantee code of that FCC ID or its holder, so no grantee code is listed.

A MAC in these blocks is therefore most likely a small Wi-Fi module or USB dongle inside another brand's set-top box, camera or appliance; that generalisation from one adapter is inferred, not stated by a source [2]. The registry also has an unrelated "RF-Link System Inc." in Hsin-Shi, Taiwan, which this entry does not cover [1].

Founding year, parent, the company's product list and its customers are unknown: the company's site did not resolve, and the FCC ID databases refused the session's requests. NVD returned no records for RF-Link, so no security notes are listed. Randomization is unknown, and in practice belongs to the host operating system rather than the module.
